verdict.rationale: The only event-to-action evidence is narrow. Budgets can send notifications to Pub/Sub topics so you can respond with cost controls (docs-9, docs-21), and Personalized Service Health offers custom alerts on incidents (docs-17). A general rule engine for triggering actions on arbitrary events is not evidenced. missing for 10: a general event-trigger/rules service (e.g. event routing to functions or workflows), documentation of defining rule conditions and actions, coverage beyond budget and incident alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
